context.passage:
From:
Mitch Dyson <mdyson@skelmonco.com.au>
To:
All Employees <employees@skelmonco.com.au>
Date:
Monday, 30 April
Subject:
Inspection
Dear staff,
The Auditing Department has informed me that it will begin auditing the company's
inventory of computer equipment on Monday, 7 May. Please leave all computers, laptops,
and monitors on your desks so that the bar codes can be scanned by the auditors. The
department hopes to complete its inspection by Friday, 11 May.
If you are missing a piece of equipment or have disposed of it, please fill out a Missing
Equipment form no later than Friday, 4 May. To obtain the form or for help in filling it
out, please stop by my office any day this week before 4:00 P.M.
Thank you,
Mitch Dyson
Administrative Assistant
Skelmon Corporation
